scientific_integrity: Analytical proof covers every integer grid size q >= 2, every replacement height m >= 2, and every replaced residue. Independent review or verification is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only two equally populated uniform grids with one frequency substitution. General sampling configurations, multiple outliers, and historic priority are not classified.
title: A parity law and sharp staggering for one-defect two-grid Fourier interpolation
